questions.s:

Pattern chal raha hai $n^2 + 1$ aur $n^2 - 1$ ka alternate!
$1^2 + 1 = 2$
$2^2 - 1 = 3$
$3^2 + 1 = 10$
$4^2 - 1 = 15$
$5^2 + 1 = 26$
$6^2 - 1 = 35$

Agla hoga $7^2 + 1 = 49 + 1 = 50$.

D(4)+5=I, K+0=K, B(2)-5=W, J+0=J. Result = IKWJ.

questions_hin.q_hi: Select the numbers that will replace the question marks (?) in the given series. 23, 25, 29, 35, 47, 50, ?, ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Pen-Free Observation: Bhai, aisi ajeeb double missing wali series ko directly alternate series se break kar aur digit multiplication check kar.

Ninja Technique:
Series 1: 23, 29, 47, ?
$\rightarrow 23 + (2 \times 3) = 29$
$\rightarrow 29 + (2 \times 9) = 47$
$\rightarrow 47 + (4 \times 7) = 75$
Series 2: 25, 35, 50, ?
$\rightarrow 25 + (2 \times 5) = 35$
$\rightarrow 35 + (3 \times 5) = 50$
$\rightarrow 50 + (5 \times 0) = 50$
Answer is 75, 50.

questions_hin.q_hi: Select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. 4, 11, 31, 65, 193, ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Pen-Free Observation: Multiplication by 2 and 3 alternate ho raha hai. Observe 31 se 65 ($\approx \times 2$) aur 65 se 193 ($\approx \times 3$).

Ninja Technique:
$\rightarrow 4 \times 2 + 3 = 11$
$\rightarrow 11 \times 3 - 2 = 31$
$\rightarrow 31 \times 2 + 3 = 65$
$\rightarrow 65 \times 3 - 2 = 193$
$\rightarrow 193 \times 2 + 3 = 386 + 3 = 389$.

questions_hin.q_hi: Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. 11, 13, 19, 49, 109, 239, ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Pen-Free Observation: Diffs dekho, jaldi pakad mein aa jayega.

Ninja Technique:
Differences: 2, 6, 30, 60, 130...
Ye number cubes ke pas hain:
$1^3 + 1 = 2$
$2^3 - 2 = 6$
$3^3 + 3 = 30$
$4^3 - 4 = 60$
$5^3 + 5 = 130$
Next aayega $6^3 - 6 = 210$.
$239 + 210 = 449$.

questions_hin.q_hi:
Select the letter-cluster that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. 

PERSONA, ANPERSO, ANOSPER, ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Method: Letter shifting ka bahut tagda question hai bhai!
Word 1: P E R S O N A
Word 2: A N P E R S O (Pichle word ke last 2 letters N aur A ko reverse karke 'AN' banaya aur front pe rakh diya).
Word 3: A N O S P E R ('AN' ko waise hi rakha, ab bache hue 'PERSO' ke last 2 letters S aur O ko reverse karke 'OS' banaya aur 'AN' ke aage chipka diya).
Word 4: Ab humare paas 'ANOSPER' hai. Hum 'ANOS' ko waise hi rakhenge, aur bache hue 'PER' ke last 2 letters E aur R ko reverse karke 'RE' banayenge aur usko aage lagayenge. Bacha hua P end mein chala jayega.
Result = A N O S + R E + P = ANOSREP.

questions_hin.q_hi: Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. FCC, UFH, OIS, LLX, FOC, ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Pen-Free Observation: Middle letter ka +3 shift clear dikh raha hai (C, F, I, L, O).

Ninja Technique:
Middle letter: O+3 = R aayega.
Last letter: C, H, S, X, C... (Yahan opposite pairs ka aapas me skip chal raha hai, ya gap dekho).
Actually First Letter F $\leftrightarrow$ U opposite chal raha hai: F, U, O, L, F. (F ka U opposite, O ka L). Toh Next U aayega.
Result seedha URH aayega.

questions_hin.q_hi: Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series. 10, 22, 35, 40, 72, 40, ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Pen-Free Observation: Dekh bhai, sequence ajeeb hai, beecho-beech same numbers aa gaye (40, 40). Ye pakka Alternate Series hai!

Ninja Technique:
Dono series ko alag kar de:
Series 1: 10, 35, 72, ?
Differences: 25, 37. Double Difference = 12.
Next Diff = $37 + 12 = 49$? Wait, let's look at diff of diff = 12? Actually 25, 37, 61. Double diffs are 12, 24.
So next diff = 61. Missing $= 72 + 61 = 133$.
Series 2: 22, 40, 40
Differences: 18, 0 (Yahan $18 \rightarrow 18-18=0$).
Option A is correct.

questions_hin.q_hi:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series. 

M T _ R M _ Q R _ V Q _ M W _ R M _ Q R
o_hi: R U M R Q Y
Q U M Q R X
Q U M R Q X
Q U S R Q R
questions_hin.s_hi:
Method: Total 20 spaces, 5 groups of 4 banenge:
M T _ R / M _ Q R / _ V Q _ / M W _ R / M _ Q R

Col 1: Sab mein 'M' constant hai. (3rd blank = M)
Col 2: T, U, V, W, X. (Yahan sequence hai +1 ka). So 2nd blank = U, 6th blank = X.
Col 3: Sab mein 'Q' constant hai. So 1st blank = Q, 5th blank = Q.
Col 4: Sab mein 'R' constant hai. So 4th blank = R.

Blanks in order: Q, U, M, R, Q, X.

questions_hin.q_hi: Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter sequence correctly. Q _ _ R R K Z _ _ K Z R T _ _ R
o_hi: Q Z R S P R
K Z R P R Z
K Z R S Z T
K Z R S K Z
questions_hin.s_hi:
Pen-Free Observation: Ek element aage shift ho raha hai. Pattern split kar 4 ke parts mein.

Ninja Technique:
Blocks: Q _ _ R | R K Z _ | _ K Z R | T _ _ R
Dekh bhai, last 3 letters K Z R constants lag rahe hain!
Q [K] [Z] R | R K Z [R] | [S] K Z R | T [K] [Z] R
Sirf pehla letter Q, R, S, T ja raha hai.
Toh missing blanks hain: K, Z, R, S, K, Z.

questions_hin.q_hi: Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following number series? 2, 3, 6, 10, 17, ?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Pen-Free Observation: Direct sum of previous differences wali trick hai (Lucas Number sequence variation).

Ninja Technique:
Differences: 1, 3, 4, 7
Notice kar: $1+3=4$, $3+4=7$. Next hoga $4+7=11$.
So $17 + 11 = 28$.
